name: Selorne
title: Glasswright of the Moonglass Hall
examine: Moonglass is worked cold, over years, the way a river works a stone. Selorne is on his eleventh lens this century and considers the pace a little hurried.
lines: Glass is a liquid that made a promise. Moonglass keeps it longer.
The Glasshouse in the delf melts starfall in a day. Impressive. Loud, but impressive.
Cold work, slow work, true work. Sit, if you like. This lens has nine years left in it.
